name: Grimoire: Clank Lorebook Importer
meta: Browser extension · Brave / Chromium · Manifest V3
desc: A custom extension for clank.world that turns bulk lorebook entry into a small ritual. Drop structured .md or .txt files and Grimoire provisions, fills, and saves dozens of memory entries automatically — using Chrome DevTools Protocol injection so reactive fields never drop or cross-wire data.
caption: the grimoire, mid-incantation ✨

stack: How to install
1. Download the .zip and extract it somewhere safe (Desktop or Documents)
2. Open brave://extensions or chrome://extensions
3. Turn Developer mode ON (top right)
4. Click Load unpacked → select the extracted clank-lorebook-importer folder
5. Done — open your Lorebook on clank.world; the UI appears bottom-right
Built with
manifest.json — Manifest V3, CDP debugger permission
background.js — OS-level Input.insertText + coordinate clicks via CDP
content.js — drop-zone parser, field traversal, save confirmation
Adjustable ritual pace + emergency STOP RITUAL kill switch
hint: Extract → brave://extensions or chrome://extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked

name: Obelisk: Clank Layout Builder
